name: Yamaha MT-09 / FZ-09
engine: 847 or 890 cc liquid-cooled inline triple, fuel injected
intro: Yamaha's crossplane triple. Several years have recalls, from headlight wiring to handlebar clamps to ECU software.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2014 FZ-09s are in recall 14V550 (headlight harness). Some 2015 bikes are in recall 15V176 (shift cam stopper). 2015-2017 bikes are in recall 17V221 (handlebar holder may loosen). Some 2021-2022 MT-09s are in recall 22V130 (ECU can stall the engine).
A-002.reason: Loose bars or a stall can cause a crash. The fixes are free.

recalls.what: Headlight harness may be too short and disconnect.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits an extension harness free.

recalls.what: Shift cam segment stopper may crack and cause shifting failure.
ECU programming may limit throttle response or stall the engine.
